description: This file defines the AccrualPeriodsData class, which manages a collection of accrual period data related to loan repayment installments, including methods to create and access specific periods.

classes.name: AccrualPeriodsData
classes.description: A data structure that holds a list of accrual periods related to loan installments, including factory and accessor methods.

methods.name: addPeriod
methods.description: Adds an AccrualPeriodData to the periods list.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method that constructs an AccrualPeriodsData object from a list of installments, setting up periods accordingly.

methods.name: getPeriodByInstallmentNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the AccrualPeriodData associated with a specific installment number.

methods.name: getFirstInstallmentNumber
methods.description: Returns the installment number of the first period.
